request.summary: Create a rotating call-center skill dashboard by aggregating existing per-agent skill-state rows.
request.audience: Call-center supervisors monitoring skill coverage and current agent activity.
request.primaryGoal: Show one skill per page with status distribution and a legible roster of participating agents.

assumptions: Placeholder rows such as _unique_agent or resourceid zero are not operational data.
The source contains state and duration records but no call-volume or service-level metrics, so the dashboard does not invent those KPIs.
Large skill rosters are capped with an explicit remaining-agent count rather than overflowing the assigned area.

settings.purpose: Message shown when no valid skills remain.
Maximum roster cards rendered for one skill.

states.expectation: Multiple skills group correctly and the active skill shows a complete status distribution.
A placeholder-only payload produces the designed empty state.
Long skill and agent names remain contained on a wide-low surface.
A roster above the configured cap reports remaining agents without overflow.
Unrecognized states receive the neutral fallback treatment.
The next alphabetically sorted skill replaces the current skill on schedule.
Updated skill membership and states appear without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: Per-agent rows aggregate into alphabetically sorted skill pages while placeholder rows are removed.
Valid skills advance alphabetically after the configured duration.
Datasource refreshes replace the visible roster and status totals in place.

visualReview.intent: A coverage-first operational dashboard with one dominant skill, an honest status distribution, and a dense but calm agent roster.
focus: Verify dense rosters retain equal row geometry and the overflow count remains visible without overlapping the footer.
Verify sentinel-only and unknown-state data never produce misleading operational totals.
